title: Match of the Day
synopsis_short: Highlights of four Premier League matches, including Manchester United v Ipswich.
synopsis_medium: Highlights of four Premier League matches, including Manchester United’s first home game of the season against newly promoted Ipswich. Xabi Alonso's Chelsea take on Brighton at Stamford Bridge.
synopsis_long: Gabby Logan presents highlights of four Premier League matches, including Manchester United’s first home game of the season against newly promoted Ipswich. Xabi Alonso’s Chelsea take on Brighton at Stamford Bridge, Brentford go to Leeds, and Sunderland host Fulham at the Stadium of Light.
synopsis_editorial: With Man Utd v Ipswich, Chelsea v Brighton, Leeds v Brentford and Sunderland v Fulham
